name: Storybird
tagline: Storybird is a creative writing platform that pairs AI-generated art with guided storytelling prompts to help children and adults create illustrated books, poems, and short stories. Teachers use it in classrooms to get students writing through a visual prompt that sparks imagination, with finished work published to a personal portfolio. The platform combines creative freedom with structure, making it particularly useful for reluctant writers who respond better to visual inspiration than a blank page.
